context: Riku and Daichi talk about enjoying a hobby.
purpose: Casual register; adverbs (せっかく/だいたい/しばしば/一気に/楽しむ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: せっかく始めたギター、楽しんでるよ。
lines.en: I'm enjoying the guitar I went to the trouble of starting.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええなあ。だいたい弾けるようになった?
lines.en: Nice. Can you roughly play now?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: だいたいの曲は、弾けるよ。
lines.style: proud teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一気に上手くなったなあ。
lines.en: You got good all at once.
lines.style: impressed Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: しばしば、夜遅くまで練習するんだ。
lines.en: I often practice late into the night.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: せっかくの才能、伸ばしや。
lines.en: Make the most of your talent.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm encouraging delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 無理せず、楽しむのが一番だよね。
lines.en: Enjoying it without overdoing it is best.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一気にやらず、楽しみながらな!
lines.en: Don't rush — enjoy it as you go!
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
